name: Trimble Inc.
moat_justification: GNSS/positioning leadership and construction-workflow software with real switching costs and ARR of $2.51B growing 14%, but roic_proxy ran only 5.0-9.8% over the last five fiscal years (goodwill-heavy balance sheet, $562.0M T&L goodwill impairment in Q2 2026) — measured returns sit around the cost of capital, so the franchise is moderate, not wide.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 0.89 vs 3-yr median 1.37 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 5.1x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
TIER_BAND: bear-case tier D (6.5%) vs bull-case tier C (11.2%) — the verdict spans tiers; size any position to the bear end
one_liner: Improving software-quality compounder, moat 6/10 — but at $59.46 the market already prices the bull case: weighted IRR 9.24%, IV@15% $30.44 vs $59.46 price; clears 15% only near $30.
moat_for: GNSS/positioning technology leadership with a large installed field base
AECO workflow software embedded in construction processes — real switching friction
ARR $2.51B, +14% YoY, with record Q2 2026 gross margins (gross margin 55.6% FY2021 → 69.1% FY2025 on software mix)
Exclusive GNSS/guidance supply agreement into PTx Trimble (AGCO) locks in a channel
moat_against: ROIC only ~5-10% through the cycle — no proven wide-moat economics yet
Serial-acquirer goodwill keeps impairing ($562.0M T&L impairment, Q2 2026)
Autodesk, Hexagon, Topcon and OEM in-sourcing (Deere, Caterpillar) competition
Construction-cycle exposure in Field Systems hardware; T&L under strategic review
Material weaknesses in internal controls disclosed in 2025, under remediation
